symptoms: Severe upward curling and cupping of leaflet margins
Pronounced interveinal chlorosis (yellowing) on young growth
Extreme plant stunting and bushy erect growth habit
Complete flower drop resulting in zero fruit set
risk_factors: Presence of sweetpotato whitefly vector (Bemisia tabaci)
Warm weather promoting rapid whitefly population spikes
prevention: Plant TYLCV-resistant hybrids (Ty-1, Ty-2, Ty-3 gene cultivars)
Use fine mesh insect netting (50 mesh) in greenhouses to exclude whiteflies
Use reflective silver mulches to repel whitefly landings
recommended_actions: Immediately rogue out and destroy infected viral plants in sealed plastic bags
Apply insecticidal soaps or systemic treatments for whitefly control
